```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Those who live on and work the land are the finest environmental stewards.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These individuals understand the need for safe water, clean air, and conservation of open space better than most.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to attempts to hamper agricultural production with heavy-handed mandates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to any expansion of the Clean Water Act to regulate ditches, culverts, converted cropland, and farm and stock ponds.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reaffirmation of traditional state supremacy over water allocations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to continue making renewable rangeland available under sound environmental conditions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for greater investment in conservation incentive programs to help rural communities improve and sustain environmental quality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Agricultural policy should be formulated by giving careful consideration to the expert opinions of farmers and ranchers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To meet surging global demand for food and biofuel, farmers must have the technology to grow higher yields using fewer inputs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The USDA must remain the international leader in agricultural research to ensure that America and the world will never have to choose between food and fuel.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. government should end mandates for ethanol and let the free market work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
